title: Netherite to Diamond
description: This resource pack changes the Netherite items textures to the Diamond one.
body:
## About
This pack changes the Netherite item textures (armor, tools, etc.) to their Diamond versions. See the list of changes below.
  - Armor
  - Horse Armor
  - Nautilus Armor
  - Weapons
  - Tools

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Preview of the pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e58e4901f25d4271ea53f58a5e2fdfe570a12f16.png)

</details>

## Utility
This pack is for those who want to bring a classic feel to their gameplay, back when the best gear and mineral were diamonds!

# Disclaimer
This pack only changes the textures and in-body vanilla models of the items. Other things, like names, are not changed. Expect only visual changes.
